satellites.title: A Gate Called Gateless
satellites.evidence: The Chan collection 無門關 makes a paradox of 門 in its title. The work is a distinct textual orbit from 不二法門.

satellites.title: The Gate of All Mysteries
satellites.evidence: Daodejing 1 ends: 玄之又玄，衆妙之門 — “dark and darker still: the gate of all mysteries.” The first chapter of the Way closes on a door.
